objective: Determine whether candidate and exact repair reach the same loss, gradient and parameter point after the controlled training objective plateaus.
optimizer: AdamW(beta1=0.9,beta2=0.95,eps=1e-8,lr=1e-4), moments start at zero and evolve separately
scope: model.norm.weight only; all other parameters frozen
outcomes: validation mean-gradient norm in both arms
claim_boundary: A plateau in this protocol is convergence of a finite-data one-carrier problem, not full-parameter LLM pretraining convergence.
